Household: 01 村长家.
DESIGN PRIORITY — A LOW HORIZONTAL L-SHAPED VILLAGE HALL-HOME, not a tall gabled cottage. One residential storey; a very broad low hipped terracotta roof without any front triangular gable. Roof ridges form an L, with the short rear return enclosing one side of an open forecourt. Warm ochre lime-plaster infill between stout sparse timber columns, a fieldstone base. A continuous deep OPEN COLONNADED VERANDA runs along the entire long front elevation and turns the corner, expressing public access and neighbor meetings. Small high rectangular windows sit below broad eaves. The domestic front door is at the inside L corner. Three porch benches and one plain table with a ledger, a shared storage chest tucked at the rear wing. Entire house about 7m long, restrained local means. Its horizontal roof canopy and repeated exposed posts must be the main silhouette, no dormers, upper floor, tower or decorative mansion details.
